objective.title: Deliver standalone exact unit catalogue and strict profile resolution

declared.summary: Close the completed exact-quantity work package and create a standalone dw.quantities.standard catalogue with deterministic profiles, exact inch/IEC and US/UK/AU volume conversions, provenance-checked AURA adaptation, independent dual RED, and full solution regressions.
declared.value: Delivers an AURA-free mathematical catalog and exact conversion vertical in one substantial run, including explicit profiles, passive localized metadata, locked NuGet restore, new package integration and eight-oracle boundary checks; leaves inherited source parity and expression integration open.
debtChanges: This is a bounded BCL-only adaptation, not a byte-for-byte or exhaustive transfer of AURA StandardUnitCatalog and StandardExpressionUnitResolver; source hashes and declarations are retained as provenance.
Australian 570 mL pint denotes an explicitly named beer-serving profile and is not claimed to be a universal statutory definition. All ambiguous cup/pint tokens demand a profile.

dw.quantities.standard presently depends on dw.quantities only; optional expression-layer integration and full inherited alias/source parity remain unfinished T2 work. No dw.localization dependency is added.

Retry 2 passed restore, build and focused regressions but plan rendering rejected the completed M1-W01 lacking an evidence array. Retry 3 attaches the four existing C01-C04 qualification reports to the completed work package.
declared.nextAction: Reconcile the inherited standard-source aliases and profile behavior against the pinned AURA files, qualify expression-layer integration and boundary coverage, and only then complete M1-W02-C01-T2 and C01.

achievements.achievement: All four accepted exact-numbers-and-quantities chunks are complete and M1-W01 is advanced from in-progress to done before activating the new unit work package.
Two independently targeted pre-transfer tests observe the absence of the standalone standard unit package and strict explicit-profile resolver, with SHA-pinned source observations.

A buildable dw.quantities.standard package is introduced with versioned exact unit constants, pure source/base/target conversion, passive metadata and explicit US/UK/AU profile selection, without dw.localization.
Seven independent exact and culture-boundary catalog tests, the full dw.quantities tests, locked solution build and foundation chain pass with bounded source adaptation evidence.
The initial standalone exact catalog and pure conversion functional contract is qualified from missing-assembly RED through buildable implementation, exact oracles and regression evidence.
The pre-implementation strict-profile resolver absence is observed as an independent RED; inherited aliases, ambiguity and integration remain explicitly open for T2 GREEN/verification.
